meta.name: Wolf
meta.description: DI Jack Caffery is a young man searching for himself. Obsessed with the neighbour he believes murdered his 10 year-old brother in the 90s, Jack finds himself trying to right the wrongs of others - but at what cost? In an isolated house in Monmouthshire, the wealthy Anchor-Ferrers family find themselves the victims of a psychopath’s cruel games, trapped and terrorised. When the two narratives collide, it’s a thrilling, nail-biting and deeply disturbing race against time.

videos.title: Watching
videos.overview: The Anchor-Ferrers arrive at their Monmouthshire home, only to be met by a gruesome surprise. In London, DI Jack Caffery receives a clue that could lead him to their rescue.

videos.title: Torture
videos.overview: DI Jack Caffery accepts the Walking Man’s mission – he must find the dog’s owner, but his past gets in the way. The Anchor-Ferrers’ home invasion takes a terrifying twist.

videos.title: Scary Man
videos.overview: Jack confronts the old Donkey Pitch case head-on while looking for Bear’s owner. Honey and Molina begin to suspect that they are not the only ones playing.

videos.title: Night Terror
videos.overview: As he probes further, Jack is convinced the Donkey Pitch killer is still at large. Meanwhile, in the house of horrors, Honey grows increasingly paranoid they are being watched.

videos.title: Death Roll
videos.overview: Another creepy gift from Penderecki sets Jack off in a new direction, but are his theories just that? Honey takes control of his predicament, only to find it is too late.

videos.title: Knock, Knock
videos.overview: When Jack unearths a clue that leads him to the Anchor-Ferrers’ home, our two narratives race forward on a nail-biting collision course.
